tests.title: the film opens with only a full-screen live watch and reveals controls by pointer or keyboard
every flight has a clear screen, captions appear only in still holds and the 42-second playback can be interrupted
a touch reveals film controls without selecting a part, while native swipe still advances the story
KARpOV has five navigable product stops that hold the real camera and mechanism still
manual controls preserve the displayed pose and resume and reload the same story position
the collection continues through real sections and loaded artwork on desktop and mobile without overflow
three finishes persist and change the actual 3D case while keeping the same viewing pose
saving a finish downloads an honest KARpOV selection card without sending data externally
reduced motion keeps a compact manual viewer and the complete commercial page
a controlled model failure preserves the collection and retries with the chosen finish
three different live mechanical models share one canvas, animate visibly and stop offscreen
a lower WebGL failure keeps matching posters and the finish selector usable
the immersive main scene recovers its real WebGL context and current story pose
initials alter the actual back-cover pixels, persist and enter the local selection card
the finale assembles all carriers, reveals the signature only after motion, and replays the original story
reduced motion gives a compact completed finale and a static engraving view
sound is silent by default, uses a real opt-in AudioContext, and pauses on simulated tab hiding
the shared watch retries its asset and restores its WebGL context with the same initials
unsupported audio leaves the live scene usable and shows a clear status
